rows.grounds: Fused form: viśeṣāt (especially) + bhasma-jaṃ (born-from-ash); sandhi t+b → db.
Object or subject described as made of ash.

items.question: What distinctive therapeutic power belongs to a liṅga fashioned from ash?
premises: A liṅga may be fashioned from ash.
An ash-born liṅga has special distinction.
items.inference: Therefore an ash-made liṅga is especially effective in removing all diseases.
items.plain_english: Especially, a liṅga made of ash removes all diseases.
